_description: Project-scoped MCP server configuration (.mcp.json). Domain 2, Task 2.4: Integrate MCP servers into Claude Code and agent workflows.

_scoping_rules.project_scoped: Place in .mcp.json at project root — version-controlled and shared with all team members
_scoping_rules.user_scoped: Place in ~/.claude.json — personal / experimental servers only, NOT shared via version control
_scoping_rules.rule: Team tooling goes in .mcp.json. Personal experiments go in ~/.claude.json.

github._description: GitHub PR, issue, and code operations. Shared team tooling.
github._credential_note: Use ${ENV_VAR} expansion — never commit tokens directly to .mcp.json

postgres._description: Read-only database access for schema inspection and query assistance
postgres._resources_note: Expose DB schema as an MCP resource so agents don't need exploratory tool calls to discover table structure

jira._description: Issue tracking integration for sprint context and ticket lookup
jira._community_server_note: Use existing community MCP servers for standard integrations (Jira, Slack, GitHub). Reserve custom MCP servers for team-specific workflows that have no existing implementation.

tool_design_reference._section: Domain 2, Tasks 2.1-2.3: Design effective tool interfaces

effective_descriptions.principle: Tool descriptions are the PRIMARY mechanism LLMs use for tool selection. Minimal or overlapping descriptions cause misrouting.

good_example.name: extract_web_results
good_example.description: Extracts structured data points from web search result pages. Input: raw HTML or text from a web page. Output: title, URL, publication date, key facts. Use for: processing search result pages. Do NOT use for: local file analysis, database queries, or code review.

effective_descriptions.lesson: Rename tools to eliminate functional overlap. 'analyze_content' vs 'analyze_document' with near-identical descriptions causes systematic misrouting.

scoped_tool_access.principle: Give each subagent ONLY the tools needed for its role. Too many tools (e.g. 18 instead of 4-5) degrade tool selection reliability by increasing decision complexity.
scoped_tool_access._note: A synthesis agent with access to search_web will attempt web searches when it should be synthesizing — scope tool access to role to prevent cross-specialization misuse

tool_choice_options.auto: Model may return text OR call a tool. Use when tool call is optional.
tool_choice_options.any: Model MUST call a tool — cannot return conversational text. Use to guarantee structured output.

forced.name: extract_metadata
forced._comment: Model MUST call this specific tool. Use to enforce sequencing in multi-step pipelines (e.g., extract_metadata must run before enrichment tools).

structured_error_responses.principle: Generic errors ('Operation failed') prevent the agent from making appropriate recovery decisions. Return structured metadata.

schema.isRetryable: boolean — true for transient errors only
schema.userMessage: Human-readable explanation safe to show to end users
schema.technicalDetail: Internal detail for logging and debugging

transient_retryable.userMessage: The service is temporarily unavailable. Retrying shortly.
transient_retryable.technicalDetail: HTTP 503 from upstream after 3 retry attempts

validation_non_retryable.userMessage: The order ID format is invalid. Order IDs must be 8 digits.

business_non_retryable.userMessage: This refund cannot be processed automatically. A manager must approve refunds over $500.
business_non_retryable.technicalDetail: Refund amount $750.00 exceeds automated approval threshold $500.00

structured_error_responses.distinguish_empty_from_error: A valid query with no results (e.g., no open tickets for this user) is NOT an error. Return an empty array with isError: false. Reserve isError: true for access failures and system errors.

mcp_resources.principle: Use MCP resources to expose content catalogs (issue summaries, DB schema, documentation hierarchy) so agents have visibility into available data without requiring exploratory tool calls.
example_resources: database_schema: complete schema for all tables — agents can plan queries without calling describe_table repeatedly
open_issues_summary: list of open sprint issues with titles and assignees — reduces exploratory list_issues calls
api_documentation: endpoint catalog with parameter schemas — agents understand available operations upfront
